narr: A quick-moving low pressure disturbance from the southwest interacted with a warm front and a very unstable atmosphere to develop and sustain multiple long-track severe thunderstorms and some flash flooding.
ev: Multiple reports from public and Roosevelt County Emergency Manager of water up to one foot high flowing over US-Highway 2 including rocks and debris.

Multiple reports of water flooding over MT-Highway 13, about 7 miles NE of Wolf Point, near mile marker 12, in an area of deep coulees. Some back roads were also washed out. A rancher in the area said he had never seen water over the road in these locations in his 85 years.
